title: TaskRequest
description: Inputs of a task: named values (JSON) + numeric seed + fidelity hint.

fidelity.description: Fidelity level requested by uncertainty-guided simulation (§8). 0 = cheapest approximation, 1 = full fidelity.

inputs.description: Named inputs; values follow the component's `input_schema`.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic reproduction.  `None` means "component default".
